Torino - Centro - Piazza Castello

title: File:Boccadasse Genova Liguria.jpg
author: EJBJane
description: This image shows a view of Boccadasse, a picturesque fishing village located in the city of Genoa, Italy. The village is characterized by its brightly colored houses tightly clustered together along the coastline, giving it a quaint and historic appearance. The buildings have an old-world Mediterranean charm with their faded pastel facades and weathered shutters. They appear to be built right up to the edge of the sea, reflecting a typical Italian coastal architecture style that maximizes the space in the steep, limited terrain. The sea is depicted with waves crashing against the shore, suggesting the photo was taken on a day with a bit rougher sea conditions. This adds a dynamic element to the image, showing the constant interplay between the village and the natural elements surrounding it.
